name: Industrial and critical infrastructure security
definition: Protecting the computers that run power grids, water plants and factories, where an attack can stop real machines.

name: Cyber policy and strategy
definition: How governments and companies plan for cyber threats, write the laws and rules, and handle attacks between countries.

name: Bioinformatics
definition: Using code and statistics to read DNA and other biological data, to understand diseases and find new treatments.

name: Geospatial science (GIS)
definition: Working with maps, satellite images and location data to plan cities, track the environment and respond to disasters.

name: Actuarial studies
definition: Using maths and statistics to measure risk and price insurance, super and pensions so they stay affordable.

name: Financial technology (FinTech)
definition: Building and running the tech behind modern money: payment apps, online banking, digital lending and blockchain.

name: Human-computer interaction
definition: Studying how people use technology and testing designs so apps and devices are easy, safe and pleasant to use.

name: Game development
definition: Designing and programming video games, from the rules and levels to the graphics engine that runs them.

name: Organisational psychology
definition: Using psychology at work: hiring the right people, building good teams and keeping staff well and motivated.

name: Human factors and safety science
definition: Designing equipment, jobs and systems around how people actually think and make mistakes, so work is safer.

name: Biostatistics and epidemiology
definition: Using statistics to track how diseases spread and to test whether medicines and health programs really work.

name: Genetic counselling
definition: Helping families understand genetic test results and inherited health risks, and make decisions about them.

name: Renewable energy engineering
definition: Designing solar, wind, battery and grid systems that produce clean power and keep it reliable.

name: Biomedical engineering
definition: Designing medical devices like implants, prosthetics and scanners that help doctors diagnose and treat people.

name: Robotics and mechatronics
definition: Building machines that sense, move and decide for themselves, mixing mechanics, electronics and code.

name: Service design
definition: Designing the whole experience of a service, like a hospital visit or a bank account, not just one screen.

name: Design strategy and innovation
definition: Using design thinking to help organisations spot new ideas, test them quickly and turn them into products.
